name: bp-orchestrator
description: Runs the nine-step pipeline for one brand and one trigger: claims the run bucket, ranks and caps the sources, collects, enriches, clusters, counts share of voice, detects alerts, drafts replies and writes the brief. No language model. A re-trigger inside the same time bucket is a no-op.

skills.name: Run the pipeline
skills.description: Takes a RunInput of brand_id, trigger, window_hours and force, and returns the RunRecord. window_hours of 0 means 24. Idempotent on (brand_id, kind, time_bucket): a second trigger in the same bucket returns the existing record and calls no peer. Fan-out is capped at 8 sources and dropped sources are named in sources_skipped with degraded_reason. Credits, tokens and cost are summed from the child artifacts, never estimated. Drafts replies; posts nothing.
examples: Run the scheduled daily pipeline for brand brd_01J9 over the last 24 hours.
Run an on-demand pipeline for brand brd_01J9 over the last 2 hours and force it even if this hour already ran.
